global: This shoyu ramen boasts a clear, amber broth with tender chashu and menma nestled among noodles. A nori sheet and naruto fish cake crown the bowl, served in a patterned ceramic dish against a vibrant red background under bright, even lighting.

regions.background: Red surface with smooth texture and rounded shape, showing slight sheen from ambient light reflection.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red dragon and geometric patterns, gold rim, smooth glossy surface.
regions.soup: Golden-brown shoyu broth with tender noodles, translucent scallions, and faintly visible toppings, all glistening in the bowl.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly glossy surface with visible veins.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show tender, marbled texture with golden-brown sear, irregular shapes, and glistening surface from broth.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear translucent, pale yellow, with layered texture and slightly curled, glossy surface.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white, spiral-swirled, scalloped-edge, slightly textured, with pink swirl center.
